dominant_strengths: Clean type hierarchy with clear weight contrast between task title, meta description, and section eyebrows
Status colors on circle indicators map intuitively to urgency, reinforced by matching date pill colors
Progress bar at the bottom anchors the card and gives a reflective summary of completion state
dominant_weaknesses: Visually generic Todoist/Things clone — nothing distinctive in layout, iconography, or interaction signaling
Color-coded circles, date pills, and category tags create three competing color systems on one row
Empty top region wastes vertical space; the date subtitle floats far from the card with no anchoring rhythm
fix_priorities: Unify the color language: pick either status-circles OR colored date pills, not both competing for attention
Tighten header-to-card spacing or introduce a richer header (filters, counts) to justify the whitespace
Add a distinctive signature element — grouping logic, drag affordance, or richer metadata — to escape genericness
Differentiate completed-state styling beyond strikethrough; the faded checkmark vs filled checkmark inconsistency reads as a bug
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral clarity is strong and visceral is competent, but reflective payoff is low because nothing makes this list memorable or ownable.
rationale.intent_fit: Solves the literal task-list brief functionally but contributes no original take on the well-trodden category.
